title: Update the required VOX implementation report
description: Update the existing required VOX implementation report with the completed persisted-media runtime and final MP4 evidence.
businessContext: The report predates the completed Scene Review, Final Preview, QA, Packaging Export, and final MP4 runtime evidence and must not retain stale completion claims.
acceptanceCriteria: The report reflects completed focused implementation milestones and names the reused services.
The report records the truthful fresh-runtime certification blocker and the completed persisted-media final MP4 result.
The report lists commits and remaining manual reviewer/QA work without claiming those gates passed.
humanEscalationConditions: Runtime evidence cannot be referenced without fabricating a provider or approval result.
